events.title: BrisScience Monthly Public Lecture
events.location: The Edge, State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: This monthly lecture series by The University of Queensland brings cutting-edge science out of the labs to the public, featuring leaders in their fields presenting on diverse topics. Held at The Edge, it aims to engage creatives and innovators across art, science, technology, and enterprise.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — GOMA Friday Nights (Up Late)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: GOMA stays open late on Friday nights during the Olafur Eliasson exhibition, offering an after-dark cultural experience with immersive art, live music, DJs, and cocktails. It transforms the gallery into a multi-sensory environment.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Ongoing Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: This Brisbane-exclusive exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson offers an expansive, multi-sensory journey that engages perception, inviting visitors to choose their path through a primordial landscape. It draws from three decades of one of the world's most influential living artists.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: This free exhibition at Brisbane Powerhouse showcases powerful photojournalism and documentary photography from around the globe, presenting a striking visual record of moments shaping our world today. It features stories of struggle, strength, and survival.

events.title: Macbeth — Shake & Stir Theatre Co (Opening Week)
events.description: Shake and Stir Theatre Company reimagines Shakespeare's tragic Macbeth as a contemporary war hero in the age of clickbait, with a ruthlessly ambitious partner. This production explores power and perception, starring Jeremiah Wray and Nelle Lee.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical (Opening Night)
events.description: Eddie Perfect's wacky musical adaptation of Tim Burton's cult film Beetlejuice makes its Brisbane debut at QPAC, bringing all its chaotic glory to the stage after a successful Melbourne premiere.

events.title: Six Characters in Search of an Author — Ad Astra (Final Week)
events.description: Luigi Pirandello's classic meta-theatrical work sees illusion and reality collide as six unfinished characters interrupt a theatre rehearsal demanding their story be told. Catch this Ad Astra production before it closes.

events.title: Game Changers: In Conversation with Lea Ea of ARROWES
events.source: State Library of Queensland / QUT / slq.qld.gov.au
events.description: This "Game Changers" event features innovation leader Lea Ea of ARROWES in conversation, sharing insights on how entrepreneurs and business leaders build companies, reinvent themselves, and envision success. Presented by State Library Queensland and QUT, it aims to inspire aspiring entrepreneurs.

events.title: Open Season 2026 — Live Music Program (Ongoing)
events.location: The Tivoli, Princess Theatre, Fish Lane, Glasshouse Theatre & more, Brisbane
events.description: Brisbane's cultural program "Open Season" returns with 100+ artists across multiple venues, featuring a lineup of international and local talent spanning jazz, hip hop, R&B, and more. Specific events during the week of June 1-7 will be part of this broader festival.

events.title: Lose to Win — Belvoir St Theatre (at QPAC Cremorne)
events.description: Belvoir St Theatre presents Lose to Win, a powerful true story where actor Mandela Mathia recounts his journey as a refugee from South Sudan to performing on Australian stages. This production is the final stop on its 2026 tour.

events.title: Camerata — Queensland's Chamber Orchestra: Revolution Remixed
events.description: Camerata, Queensland's Chamber Orchestra, presents "Revolution Remixed," a concert reimagining classical masterpieces like Beethoven's Symphony No. 3 and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition for dynamic chamber performance. The program showcases precision, passion, and collaborative spirit.

events.title: Queensland Ballet — Hamlet (Running in June)
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents Hamlet, a dance drama choreographed by Leo Mujić that retells Shakespeare's tragedy of love, corruption, and power. This 2026 season production celebrates ballet's power to connect generations, disciplines, and cultures.

events.title: Opera Queensland — Rusalka (Running in June)
events.description: Opera Queensland presents Dvořák's Rusalka at QPAC, a shimmering fairytale opera inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's The Little Mermaid. This production reunites an acclaimed creative team for a story of love, sacrifice, and longing.

events.title: QAGOMA Free Exhibition — Faith, Visual Culture & Oleographs
events.description: This free QAGOMA exhibition explores faith and visual culture through stunning and rare oleographs from the late 1800s, created in collaboration with conservationists from Bengaluru, India. It offers insight into how the divine manifests in daily life across cultures.

events.title: Crocodile Showcase — Queensland Museum Kurilpa (Ongoing)
events.description: The Queensland Museum Kurilpa hosts a major exhibition focused on crocodiles, one of Earth's most formidable predators. This showcase provides an in-depth look at these creatures.

events.title: Lindy Lee AO in Conversation — State Library Queensland
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: Esteemed artist Lindy Lee AO engages in an evening conversation at the State Library of Queensland, offering insights into her work, creative process, and artistic perspective. This free event will likely touch on themes of culture and creativity.
